title: Quiet with Christ
text: In silence and stillness your soul finds its home. Listen as you move; His voice is gentle, a whisper beneath the noise. (1 Kings 19:12)

title: Selah moment
text: Meditate on His love day and night. Let the rhythm of your steps become a prayer without words. Pause. Selah. (Psalm 1:2)

title: A still small voice
text: And after the earthquake a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire the sound of a low whisper. (1 Kings 19:12)
kjv: And after the earthquake a fire; but the LORD was not in the fire: and after the fire a still small voice. (1 Kings 19:12, KJV)

title: Deep calls to deep
text: Deep calls to deep at the roar of your waterfalls. Let the quiet places of this walk draw out the deep places of your heart before God. (Psalm 42:7)

title: Mary's choice
text: But one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen the good portion, which will not be taken away from her. (Luke 10:42)
kjv: But one thing is needful: and Mary hath chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her. (Luke 10:42, KJV)

title: Evening reflection
text: As the day settles, review it with Jesus. Where was he near? Thank him for one hidden grace you almost missed. (Psalm 4:4)

title: Search me, O God
text: Search me, O God, and know my heart! Try me and know my thoughts! And see if there be any grievous way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting! (Psalm 139:23-24)
kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting. (Psalm 139:23-24, KJV)

title: The examen walk
text: Walk slowly through today's memories with Christ. Notice consolation and desolation. Ask him what he wants to show you. Then rest. (Psalm 139:23)

title: In quietness and trust
text: In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and in trust shall be your strength. (Isaiah 30:15)
kjv: In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength. (Isaiah 30:15, KJV)

title: Night watch
text: On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night. Let sleepless thoughts become prayers. He keeps watch with you. (Psalm 63:6)
